title: alyssum montanum var. pedemontanum
intro: Alyssum montanum var. pedemontanum, commonly known as Mountain Sweet Alyssum, is a flowering plant species within the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Sweet Alyssum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which can aid in relieving congestion and coughing. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Sweet Alyssum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
